title: JobHistoryRepository
responsibility: Persist idempotent job attempts in a per-user SQLite WAL store shared by worktrees and concurrent runners.

inputs.name: JobHistoryRepository.constructor.home
inputs.description: Defaults to HARNESS_JOBS_HOME, then ~/.codex/harness/jobs; the directory is created with private permissions.

inputs.name: JobHistoryRepository.start.input
inputs.description: Lifecycle record validated before persistence: nonempty identity, positive attempt and finite nonnegative timestamps. Completed records require outcome and matching duration.

inputs.name: JobHistoryRepository.end.input
inputs.description: Lifecycle record validated before persistence: nonempty identity, positive attempt and finite nonnegative timestamps. Completed records require outcome and matching duration.

inputs.name: JobHistoryRepository.import.input
inputs.description: Lifecycle record validated before persistence: nonempty identity, positive attempt and finite nonnegative timestamps. Completed records require outcome and matching duration.

outputs.name: JobHistoryRepository.start
outputs.description: Stored attempt, preserving the first start when the same source-job-attempt is recorded again.

outputs.name: JobHistoryRepository.end
outputs.description: Completed stored attempt with elapsed milliseconds and outcome; duplicate completion preserves the first outcome and timing.

outputs.name: JobHistoryRepository.import
outputs.description: True for an inserted record or a one-time correction of an earlier inferred reverify aggregate into its first attempt; false for duplicates. Completed runner-clock records are never overwritten.

outputs.name: JobHistoryRepository.all
outputs.description: All stored job records in insertion order, including unfinished and cancelled records for callers to classify.

outputs.name: JobHistoryRepository.close
outputs.description: No return value; closes the SQLite connection.

errors.name: RangeError
errors.description: Rejects invalid lifecycle timing, identity or scheduling flags before the operation can record or estimate work.

errors.name: SQLiteError
errors.description: Filesystem permissions, SQLite opening, busy-timeout, SQL or connection errors propagate; end rolls back its transaction before rethrowing.
